name: getmattered
description: Auto-Apply That Ends on an Interview. Your matched jobs, applications on the employer's own hiring system, a review queue, employer receipts and interview preparation.
long_description: GetMattered finds jobs matched to your resume, tailors the resume and cover letter for each role, and submits the application on the employer's own hiring system across 30+ hiring systems. Each application is sent automatically or held for your approval. The extension runs the getmattered-mcp bridge, which relays every message to the hosted server at https://mcp.getmattered.com/mcp. On the first tool call without a stored sign-in, it opens your browser once to sign in.
